sqlite_master.name: storage
sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TABLE storage (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                url TEXT,
                identifier TEXT,
                element_data TEXT,
                UNIQUE (url, identifier)
            )

schema_sql_literal:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS storage (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                url TEXT,
                identifier TEXT,
                element_data TEXT,
                UNIQUE (url, identifier)
            )
insert_sql_literal:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO storage (url, identifier, element_data)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?)
select_sql_literal: SELECT element_data FROM storage WHERE url = ? AND identifier = ?
